# Repositories

Every OpenDXL repository, grouped by what it does. All of them are Apache-2.0 unless the
table says otherwise. The upstream projects live under
[github.com/opendxl](https://github.com/opendxl); the SIEM sensor is new work of this fork
and has no upstream counterpart.

The version shown is the version declared in the repository, which for most of these is also
the last published release. Read [Compatibility](compatibility.md) before pinning any of them.

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_repositories.py from data/repositories.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Core clients

The libraries that speak the DXL protocol directly.

### [opendxl-client-python](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-client-python)

*Python · v5.7.0.1 · Apache-2.0*

The OpenDXL Python Client enables the development of applications that connect to the
Trellix Data Exchange Layer messaging fabric for the purposes of sending/receiving events
and invoking/providing services.

### [opendxl-client-java](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-client-java)

*Java · Apache-2.0*

The OpenDXL Java Client enables the development of applications that connect to the Trellix
Data Exchange Layer messaging fabric for the purposes of sending/receiving events and
invoking/providing services.

### [opendxl-client-javascript](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-client-javascript)

*JavaScript · v0.1.4 · Apache-2.0*

The OpenDXL JavaScript Client (Node.js) enables the development of applications that connect
to the Trellix Data Exchange Layer messaging fabric for the purposes of sending/receiving
events and invoking/providing services.

### [opendxl-streaming-client-python](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-streaming-client-python)

*Python · v0.1.2 · Apache-2.0*

The OpenDXL Streaming Python client library is used to consume records from and produce
records to a Data Exchange Layer (DXL) Streaming Service.

### [opendxl-streaming-client-java](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-streaming-client-java)

*Java · Apache-2.0*

The OpenDXL Streaming Java client library is used to consume records from as well as to
produce records to a Data Exchange Layer (DXL) Streaming Service.

### [opendxl-streaming-client-javascript](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-streaming-client-javascript)

*JavaScript · v0.1.1 · Apache-2.0*

The OpenDXL Streaming JavaScript client library is used to consume records from and produce
records to a Data Exchange Layer (DXL) Streaming Service.

### [opendxl-databus-client-java](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-databus-client-java)

*Java · unspecified*

The OpenDXL Databus Java client library is used to consume and produce records from/to a
Data Exchange Layer (DXL) Streaming Service.

## Product client libraries

## Services

Long-running processes that register a request topic and answer on it, normally by calling a third-party API.

### [opendxl-epo-service-python](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-epo-service-python)

*Python · v0.2.0 · Apache-2.0*

The Trellix ePolicy Orchestrator (ePO) DXL Python service exposes access to ePO's remote
commands via the Data Exchange Layer (DXL) fabric.

### [opendxl-virustotal-service-python](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-virustotal-service-python)

*Python · v0.2.0 · Apache-2.0*

The VirusTotal DXL Python service exposes access to the VirusTotal API via the Data Exchange
Layer (DXL) fabric.

### [opendxl-misp-service-python](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-misp-service-python)

*Python · v0.1.5 · Apache-2.0*

The MISP DXL Python Service exposes access to the MISP REST APIs via the Data Exchange Layer
(DXL) fabric. The service also provides support for forwarding MISP ZeroMQ message
notifications to the DXL fabric.

### [opendxl-maxmind-service-python](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-maxmind-service-python)

*Python · v0.2.1 · Apache-2.0*

The MaxMind DXL Python service exposes Host/IP Geolocation lookups in a MaxMind GeoLite2 or
GeoIP2 database via the Data Exchange Layer (DXL) fabric.

### [opendxl-domaintools-service-python](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-domaintools-service-python)

*Python · v0.2.1 · Apache-2.0*

The DomainTools DXL Python service exposes access to the DomainTools API via the Data
Exchange Layer (DXL) fabric.

### [opendxl-elasticsearch-service-python](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-elasticsearch-service-python)

*Python · v0.2.0 · Apache-2.0*

The Elasticsearch DXL Python service exposes access to the Elasticsearch REST APIs via the
Data Exchange Layer (DXL) fabric. The service also provides support for storing event
notifications received from the DXL fabric to Elasticsearch.

### [opendxl-urlvoid-service-python](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-urlvoid-service-python)

*Python · v0.2.0 · Apache-2.0*

The URLVoid DXL Python service exposes access to the URLVoid API via the Data Exchange Layer
(DXL) fabric.

### [opendxl-thehive-service-python](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-thehive-service-python)

*Python · v0.1.0 · Apache-2.0*

TheHive DXL Python Service exposes access to the TheHive REST APIs via the Data Exchange
Layer (DXL) fabric.

## Node-RED nodes

Flow nodes for Node-RED.

### [node-red-contrib-dxl](https://github.com/opendxl/node-red-contrib-dxl)

*JavaScript · v0.1.4 · Apache-2.0*

The Node-RED OpenDXL contribution package enables the development of flows in Node-RED which
connect to the Data Exchange Layer messaging fabric for the purposes of sending/receiving
events and invoking/providing services.

### [node-red-contrib-dxl-epo-client](https://github.com/opendxl/node-red-contrib-dxl-epo-client)

*JavaScript · v0.1.1 · Apache-2.0*

The Trellix ePolicy Orchestrator (ePO) DXL Node-RED client package enables the development
of flows in Node-RED which invoke ePO remote commands via the Data Exchange Layer (DXL)
fabric.

### [node-red-contrib-dxl-tie-client](https://github.com/opendxl/node-red-contrib-dxl-tie-client)

*JavaScript · v0.1.0 · Apache-2.0*

The Trellix Threat Intelligence Exchange (TIE) DXL Node-RED client package enables the
development of flows in Node-RED which use TIE features (manage reputations, determine where
a file has executed, etc.) via the Data Exchange Layer (DXL) fabric.

### [node-red-contrib-dxl-mar-client](https://github.com/opendxl/node-red-contrib-dxl-mar-client)

*JavaScript · v0.1.0 · Apache-2.0*

The Trellix Active Response (MAR) DXL Node-RED client package enables the development of
flows in Node-RED which perform MAR searches via the Data Exchange Layer (DXL) fabric.

### [node-red-contrib-dxl-pxgrid-client](https://github.com/opendxl/node-red-contrib-dxl-pxgrid-client)

*JavaScript · v0.1.1 · Apache-2.0*

The Cisco pxGrid DXL Node-RED client package enables the development of flows in Node-RED
which communicate with Cisco pxGrid via the Data Exchange Layer (DXL) fabric.

## Tooling and scaffolding

Generators, consoles and developer tooling.

### [opendxl-bootstrap-python](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-bootstrap-python)

*Python · v0.2.2 · Apache-2.0*

The purpose of the OpenDXL Bootstrap application is to generate the structure and related
files necessary (a project) for developing a Data Exchange Layer (DXL) integration with
Python. Multiple templates are available which control the type of project to generate (a
client wrapper, a persistent application which…

### [opendxl-bootstrap-javascript](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-bootstrap-javascript)

*JavaScript · v0.1.1 · Apache-2.0*

The OpenDXL Bootstrap JavaScript library includes helpers for developing a Data Exchange
Layer integration with JavaScript. The helpers extend the basic functionality of the OpenDXL
JavaScript Client (Node.js).

### [opendxl-console](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-console)

*Python · v0.3.3 · Apache-2.0*

The OpenDXL Console is a pluggable web-based console that provides a high-level user
interface for interacting with a DXL fabric. One of the primary modules is the "Fabric
Monitor" which enables the invocation of DXL services and sending/receiving DXL events via a
graphical interface.

### [bootprint-opendxl](https://github.com/opendxl/bootprint-opendxl)

*JavaScript · v0.1.4 · Apache-2.0*

This package contains a template, partials and styles for bootprint to convert OpenDXL-
Specifications into a static HTML-page.

### [opendxl-build-status](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-build-status)

*— · unspecified*

This purpose of this repository is to provide a single place to see the status of all
OpenDXL builds.

### [opendxl-siem-sensor](https://github.com/JMuellerTX/opendxl-siem-sensor)

*Rust · v0.1.0 (in development) · Apache-2.0*

Monitoring sensor for a DXL fabric: subscribes to the registry and connect events, keeps a
model of services, clients and brokers, normalises everything to OCSF and CEF and forwards
it to a SIEM over syslog, HTTP/JSON or Kafka. Detects legacy cipher suites, unknown
certificate thumbprints, publishers on sensitive…

## Containers and environments

The fabric itself and the ready-made environments around it. The broker has its own page: see [The broker](broker/index.md).

### [opendxl-broker](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-broker)

*— · Apache-2.0*

The OpenDXL Broker is an open source version of a Data Exchange Layer (DXL) broker. The
broker executes in a standalone mode and does not require an external management interface.
The only currently supported packaged delivery mechanism for the OpenDXL Broker is a Docker
image.

### [opendxl-environment](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-environment)

*— · Apache-2.0*

The OpenDXL Environment is a pre-configured environment available as a Docker image that
supports the development and running of OpenDXL solutions.

### [opendxl-node-red-docker](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-node-red-docker)

*— · Apache-2.0*

This repository contains the files necessary to build a Docker image that consists of the
core Node-RED installation along with a set of standard OpenDXL Node-RED extensions.

### [opendxl-cuckoo-reporting-module](https://github.com/opendxl/opendxl-cuckoo-reporting-module)

*— · other*

The OpenDXL Cuckoo Reporting Module provides a reporting module for Cuckoo Sandbox. When
this module is installed in a Cuckoo environment, it will broadcast Cuckoo report analyses
as DXL events on a DXL Fabric. This module is for Cuckoo Sandbox 2.0.5 or greater. Please
see the Cuckoo Reporting Modules documentation…

Contracts rather than code: how a DXL solution describes its API.

*— · Apache-2.0*

### [mcafee-dxl-schemas](https://github.com/opendxl/mcafee-dxl-schemas)

*— · unspecified*

This repository is comprised of DXL schemas for Trellix-related products

### [mvision-api-developer-guide](https://github.com/opendxl/mvision-api-developer-guide)

*— · unspecified*

Sample code and developer notes for the MVISION (now Trellix) cloud APIs: device, threat-
event and event-by-group endpoints, with runnable examples in Python, Go and TypeScript. Not
a DXL client - it documents the REST side of the platform that DXL integrations are
frequently combined with.
